comment: zap.c bhitpile() 2469-2478 and 2501: the hidingunder branch. A debug elven Wizard drops her whole inventory (D, A, a; ESC skips the drop messages), turns into a snake with #polyself, hides under the pile with #monster (u.uundetected with hides_under()), and casts force bolt downward: zap_updown() calls bhitpile() with zz > 0, which skips the top item and breaks the potions below, then maybe_unhide_at() runs. Zapping up never reaches bhitpile() (zap_updown() calls it only for u.dz > 0 or probing down), so 2474-2476 stay unrun.
